sections.text_helper: Section 78.11 "Cortex-M55 debug features" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4416.
sections.section_content:
The Cortex-M55 integrates the following CoreSight components:
• Cortex-M55 ROM table
• Cortex-M55 SCS (system control space)
• BPU (breakpoint unit)
• DWT (data watchpoint and trace unit)
• ITM (instrumentation trace macrocell)
• ETM (Embedded Trace Macrocell)
• CTI (cross trigger interface)
These components are accessible by the debugger via the Cortex-M55 AHB-AP.
